scope: Focused exact-result comparison, not review of all seven Ferudun theorems

rows.current_v3: K_PS(alpha prime)=epsilon*K_PS(alpha)-ell mod(n-2), n>=3, actual alpha/alpha prime in closed source sector, ell even for even n; first-vertex existence
rows.contemporary_primary: Ferudun Theorem B p5, proof pp16–17; same for n>=4. The omitted n3 case has one type and is elementary.
rows.assessment: Exact nontrivial all-n overlap; n3 does not establish a novel discovery.

rows.current_v3: Parity selects sum when segment count odd and difference when even; sides use residue n-2=0; direct chords recover j-1. Bare A0 shorthand is globally invalid.
rows.contemporary_primary: Ferudun Definition1.1 and Remark1.2 pp2–3, Lemmas2.3–2.4 p11; same formulas and direct-diagonal explanation.
rows.assessment: Same repaired convention and exceptional-ray issue already explicit.

rows.current_v3: At alpha=pi/n and beta=3pi/n bare label0 plus ell2,epsilon-1 fixes the chord but demands -2, impossible for n>=5.
rows.contemporary_primary: Ferudun Remark1.2(b) p3 states all direct diagonals have beta-alpha=2pi/n while parity labels differ; Theorem B gives the signed rule for selected labels.
rows.assessment: This exact fixed-ray contradiction is not separately stated in the inspected source, but is an immediate deduction from its explicit chord formulas and distinction. No substantive novelty clearance.

rows.current_v3: L_theta=(phi-theta)/pi mod N; K_PS=b-a; synchronized even cones
rows.contemporary_primary: Ferudun Section2.2 pp10–11: B=s*omega+corner offset mod N*pi and K=(B_terminal-B_initial)/pi; Lemma2.3 identifies physical type.
rows.assessment: Under corner t congruent s mod n, B congruent phi mod N*pi, so the two indices coincide for P0-normalized physical trajectories.

rows.current_v3: One affine map shifts every forward/backward label equally; model chords obey a+b=-h; transport gives b=C_theta-a.
rows.contemporary_primary: Ferudun B-uniformity pp11–12; Lemma2.10 pp14–15 establishes generator uniformity; Lemma3.1 p16 uses chord-end reflection B_terminal=C-B_initial and transports initial differences by the same angular lift.
rows.assessment: Same target mechanism. Current V3 proves a common-shift claim for all orientation-preserving affine maps using hyperelliptic centrality; Ferudun needs only an explicit uniform subgroup. Difference in sufficient machinery is not novelty clearance.

rows.current_v3: Explicit cylinders on actual double, common shear2cot(pi/n), finite-length descent to symmetry-direction chords; compact/CAT(0) finiteness proof
rows.contemporary_primary: Ferudun Lemma2.8 p13, Lemma2.10 pp14–15, Lemma2.11 p15, Lemma2.12 p15. Same uniform modulus and finite shortening; finiteness proved by bounded polygon-crossing chains.
rows.assessment: Direct descent also overlaps, though coordinates and finiteness proofs differ.
